title.orig: 名所江戸百景 浅草金龍山
title.zh: 名所江户百景 浅草金龙山

medium.en: Woodblock print; ink and colour on paper

institution.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
institution.credit_line: The Howard Mansfield Collection, Purchase, Rogers Fund, 1936

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1858. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1858 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A view through the great gate of Sensō-ji in Edo: a huge red paper lantern hangs across the top, and beyond it the temple hall and a five-storey pagoda stand in falling snow, with small figures under umbrellas crossing the white courtyard.
alt.zh: 从江户浅草寺的大门向里看：一盏巨大的红纸灯笼横在画面上方，远处的殿堂和五重塔立在飘雪中，几个撑伞的小人走过白色的庭院。

note.en: From One Hundred Famous Views of Edo, the great series of Hiroshige's last years. He frames the view through the gate and lets the top edge cut the lantern off, a device that later caught the eye of European painters. The lantern is the warmest thing in a cold picture, which is reason enough for it to hang in a library that keeps its lamps lit.
note.zh: 出自广重晚年的巨作《名所江户百景》。他透过山门取景，让画面上缘把灯笼截断，这种构图后来让欧洲画家着迷。灯笼是这幅冷画里最暖的东西，单凭这一点，它就该挂在一座一直亮着灯的图书馆里。
